initial_observation.problem: The Oracle record was expanded to 2025-01-01..2025-12-31, and an answer consequently described it as a full-year fact. The source only said the user used Oracle at some unspecified time in 2025.

repair.prompt_rule: A year mention with '曾经/用过/发生过' does not mean the fact held for the whole year; keep year precision and do not invent month/day.
repair.rerun_input: 2025 年曾经使用过 Oracle 数据库
repair.stored_content: 2025年曾经使用过 Oracle 数据库。这是用户于 2026-10-10 明确要求记录的历史事实，具体使用时段未指明。
repair.answer: 2025年曾经使用过 Oracle 数据库。

limitations: The initial round is a small synthetic scenario, not an accuracy benchmark.
